sn56.19:1.1: idaṃ dukkhaṃ ariyasaccanti bhikkhave, mayā paññattaṃ.
sn56.19:1.2: tattha aparimāṇā vaṇṇā, aparimāṇā vyañjanā, aparimāṇā saṅkāsanā.
sn56.19:1.4: idaṃ dukkhasamudayo ariyasaccanti bhikkhave mayā paññattaṃ. tattha aparimāṇā vaṇṇo, aparimāṇā vyañjanā, aparimāṇā saṅkāsanā. itipidaṃ dukkhasamudayo ariyasaccanti.
sn56.19:1.5: idaṃ dukkha nirodho ariyasaccanti bhikkhave, mayā paññattaṃ. tattha aparimāṇā vaṇṇā, aparimāṇā vyañjanā, aparimāṇā saṅkāsanā. itipidaṃ dukkhanirodho ariyasaccanti.
sn56.19:1.6: idaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ariyasaccanti bhikkhave, mayā paññattaṃ.
sn56.19:1.7: tattha aparimāṇā vaṇṇā aparimāṇā vyañjanā aparimāṇā saṅkāsanā.
sn56.19:2.1: tasmātiha bhikkhave, idaṃ dukkhanti yogo karaṇīyo …pe… ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yogo karaṇīyoti.
